metadata.summary: Liverpool have an agreement in principle with Paris Saint-Germain to sign Bradley Barcola for a package worth £120m.
metadata.content: Bradley Barcola transfer news: Liverpool reach £120m deal in principle for PSG forward | Football News | Sky Sports Skip to content Bradley Barcola transfer news: Liverpool reach £120m deal in principle for PSG forward Liverpool have reached a £120m deal in principle to sign PSG forward Bradley Barcola; deal not finalised yet but major breakthrough in talks; there has been a gap in valuation between two clubs throughout summer, with PSG asking for around £145m for Barcola By Mark McAdam and Lyall Thomas Thursday 27 August 2026 14:14, UK Please use Chrome browser for a more accessible video player What are the four things Liverpool fans should know about transfer target Bradley Barcola? Liverpool have an agreement in principle with Paris Saint-Germain to sign Bradley Barcola for a package worth £120m. The deal has not been finalised, with last details still being discussed, but there has been a breakthrough in negotiations. There had been a gap in valuation between the two clubs throughout the summer, with PSG previously asking for around £145m for the France international.
